name: Niederkrüchten (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically blue and yellow below a white banner head bearing the municipal arms of Niederkrüchten (a bird and a lion on red beside blue and white bars).
history: The banner is described as blue and yellow striped lengthwise 1:1 beneath a white banner head containing the municipal shield.

features.role: Niederkrüchten arms — bird, lion and bars
